understanding: t_clk_cov is coverage-only sampling of observed CLK period on wb_clk_i with per-instance false requiring fixed period per test from t_bringup_clk. DOCUMENTED evidence confirms CLK input role and WISHBONE clock table points with SoC deferral. Band stratum boundary min-max resolution and directed nominal-min-max plus random low-middle-high settings remain INFERRED quick-test navigation only and prove only finite sample.
preconditions: Clock stable at symbolic fixed SYM_PERIOD before reset and traffic with no dynamic change pending
Reset assert then deassert coordination complete with wishbone_bus and serial_data and modem_control_if idle
wb_clk_i driven by clock with all DUT inputs owned or tied and period change allowed only between tests before reset
stimulus_steps: SET clock to SYM_PERIOD for this test before reset and HOLD fixed through reset and traffic
EXECUTE reset assert then deassert then WAIT SYM_IDLE_CYCLES clock cycles for idle
HOLD wishbone_bus and serial_data and modem_control_if idle while clock edges accumulate for sampling
coverage_steps: SAMPLE observed clock edges from clock monitor analysis port on each observed edge of wb_clk_i with per-instance false
SAMPLE SYM_OBSERVED_PERIOD into symbolic point bins tracing documented Clocks table points
SAMPLE stratum and boundary into symbolic low_stratum middle_stratum high_stratum and nominal min max boundary
IF observed period falls in unlisted gap THEN EXCLUDE as never-sampled ignore without DUT failure
FOR each test RECORD single fixed SYM_PERIOD and prove only finite sample exercised not exhaustive frequency proof
completion: WAIT until SYM_MIN_EDGES observed clock edges sampled and coverage recorded
ENFORCE testbench operational timeout TEST_TIMEOUT_CYCLES as limit not as DUT timing requirement
CLEANUP return wishbone_bus and serial_data and modem_control_if to idle and release coordination handles
